credits.title: Where the Forest Thickens
credits.overview: A fusion of film and theatre based on the play of the same title by Micomicon. The film shows the play and its creative process.  After her mother's death, Antonia finds a box which takes her and her daughter on a trip through Europe to former Yugoslavia. Remembrance, exhumations and wars. Life will not be the same.

credits.title: La española inglesa
credits.overview: In 1596, a Spanish girl, Isabel, is kidnapped by the English during the Capture of Cádiz and sent to England, where, already an adult woman, she falls in love with her kidnapper's son.

credits.title: Map of Memories of Madrid
credits.overview: A Documentary seeks the encounter between people, the collective memory of the city of Madrid.

credits.title: Maktub
credits.overview: The title refers to those strange coincidences that happen to us sometimes and that seem inevitable, like a product of destiny. Inspired by the experience of a Canarian child victim of cancer, the film is conceived as a Christmas story.
